validation_architecture_finding.detail: fs_cal2_spine.rs references ReceiverHost 0 times; it models the peer abstractly (Chan + ack queue, no AEAD/session). Locked/fresh panels can validate the SENDER machine with a harness peer mirroring the product responder — legitimate ONLY because the responder will exist and be independently tested (the precise difference from the DR-CS-2B rejection).

crates/crypto/src/lib.rs is a 3-line skeleton; 0 refs to x25519/snow/Handshake. ReceiverHost::open_session takes INJECTED directional keys ('Product: gerçek-handshake-Split()'). A faithful two-netns run is therefore possible only with test-injected keys; the authenticated path is real but key establishment is not. Bounds any §8.4/§9 end-to-end claim; gated on Sprint-6.
